SOCIAL_COMMENTS.SHADOW_MODE: Shadow mode: the AI proposes a decision for every comment but nothing is done on Facebook or Instagram.

REVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Confirm or correct each proposed decision to measure how accurate the AI is before letting it act.
REVIEW.EMPTY_STATE: No comments match these filters yet.

INSIGHTS.DESCRIPTION: How people talk about the brand in Facebook and Instagram comments.
INSIGHTS.EMPTY_STATE: No comments in this period yet.
INSIGHTS.TOPICS_NOTE: Topics ordered by volume, with the sentiment of their comments.

SETTINGS.TOPICS_NOTE: The AI tags every comment with these topics so recurring complaints and questions show up in the insights. Anything else is tagged as Other.
SETTINGS.TOPICS_PLACEHOLDER: Add a topic and press Enter
SETTINGS.SETUP_NOTE: To receive and delete comments, subscribe the feed (Page) and comments (Instagram) webhook fields in the Meta app, add the instagram_business_manage_comments permission and the "Manage everything on your Page" use case (pages_manage_engagement). Then reconnect the Facebook and Instagram inboxes so they request the new permissions.
SETTINGS.AUTO_DELETE_NOTE: Delete comments from Facebook and Instagram as soon as the AI marks them as Remove with enough confidence. Deleted comments cannot be recovered; lower-confidence ones stay in the review queue.

SOCIAL_COMMENTS.AUTO_DELETE_MODE: Automatic deletion is on: comments the AI marks as Remove with at least {confidence}% confidence are deleted from Facebook and Instagram.
